review_findings.summary: packages/domain/src/audit/index.ts still embeds a raw SQL INSERT literal, drifting from domain-boundaries.md's 'pure TS' scope -- unresolved, needs a follow-up ticket or ADR.
The narrow UPDATE exception would become a live attribution-erasure path for service_role if any future migration re-grants UPDATE -- GRANT layer is the real backstop.
TRUNCATE test accepts a broad regex, doesn't prove the statement-level trigger specifically fires; no SELECT policy/test exists yet for audit_logs (expected, audit.read not enforced yet).
gitleaks regex allowlist is repo-wide, not path-scoped -- optional hardening.
packages/database still has no lint script despite now holding a 339-line test file.

residual_risks: tenant_id 'on delete restrict' means tenant deletion (ticket #36 GDPR erasure) needs an explicit privileged audit purge path -- must be implemented or tenant deletion will fail in production.
No SELECT policy/grant on audit_logs yet -- audit reads are service_role-only until audit.read lands.
recordAuditEvent() has no test of its own proving validate-before-insert ordering can't regress.
analytics_events remains FK-less until Epic 4/6; no retention/partitioning story for audit_logs.
